_comment: Exceptions for scripts/credential-check.mjs. Each entry needs `path`, `pattern` (a pattern id from the scanner) and a `reason`. An entry that matches nothing FAILS the check, so this file cannot rot into a blanket exemption. Adding an entry means a human looked at the string and decided it is not a live credential — say why in the reason, and say so plainly when the surrounding code was not read directly.

entries.reason: Redaction fixture. SENTINELS.password = 'SENTINEL-PASSWORD-8e3b' — a hand-written marker, not a credential: the file's whole purpose is to prove these sentinels do NOT survive into the support bundle.
Redaction fixture. A PEM header planted in a hostile-source stub so the support bundle's scrubber has something to remove.

Read directly (this whole file). The match is in the FIRST entry's `reason` STRING, which quotes the literal sentinel it classifies ('SENTINEL-PASSWORD-8e3b') in order to explain why that sentinel is not a credential. The scanner reads this file as text, so the explanation of an exemption trips the rule the exemption documents. The value is a hand-written marker in packages/cli/src/support-bundle.test.ts — the same string already covered by the entry above it.
